patterns.note: Full-bleed hero section featuring a background video, followed by a mix of grid-based product cards and full-width content sections.
Headings use a large, bold sans-serif font for impact, while body text is clear and readable, often accompanied by smaller uppercase labels for categories or sub-sections.
A high-contrast palette of deep dark blues/blacks and crisp whites is accented by a vibrant array of reds, pinks, and purples used in product imagery and occasional UI elements.

The primary navigation bar at the top shrinks in height and gains a solid background upon scroll, remaining sticky. A secondary product category bar, initially below the hero, becomes temporarily sticky at the bottom of the viewport before scrolling out of view. Content sections below the hero reveal with a subtle fade-up animation as they enter the viewport.
Feature sections often pair a prominent headline with a grid of product or solution cards, sometimes using a split layout with imagery on one side and text on the other.

technique_notes: The hero section employs a full-bleed background video with a dark, semi-transparent overlay to ensure text readability. The main navigation bar transitions its height and background color on scroll, maintaining a sticky position at the top. A unique secondary navigation bar is programmed to become sticky at the bottom of the viewport for a specific scroll range, then un-sticks. Content sections below the hero are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, typically a subtle fade and slight upward translation, as they become visible in the user's viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with clear, readable body text and smaller uppercase labels for categories.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (cards, buttons, input fields), creating a soft, approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with airy padding in hero and main content sections, transitioning to a denser layout in feature grids and the extensive footer.

standout: This site distinguishes itself with a sophisticated motion design system, particularly the dynamic sticky behavior of both the top navigation and a unique, temporarily sticky product category bar at the bottom of the viewport. The full-bleed video hero also sets a high visual standard, making the site feel premium and engaging beyond a standard marketing template.
